skina.description: The plastic cap where two sliding sashes meet. Contains brush pile seal to prevent air leaks through the middle.
skina.usage: Critical component for sliding windows. Without this, air and dust leak through the middle gap between sashes.

barour_shabaak.description: Special profile that clips onto frame to create secondary rebate for screen sash in Panda systems.

technicalDetails.purpose: Creates secondary rebate for screen sash

barour_shabaak.usage: Enables Panda system to have both glass sash and screen sash on the same frame. The adapter pushes the screen sash outward by 12-18mm.

takoz.description: Plastic packers used to 'toe and heel' glass in sash, preventing sagging and water pooling.
takoz.usage: Critical for preventing glass sagging. Glass cannot just sit on metal - it needs plastic packers to maintain correct position. Without shims, the sash will sag and water will pool.

hars_taleeq.description: Plastic pieces inserted in the top track to prevent the sash from being lifted out (burglary protection).
hars_taleeq.usage: Security component. Prevents sash from being lifted out of the track from outside. Essential for sliding windows in ground floor or accessible locations.

zawya.description: Aluminum corner connector for sash assembly. Can be crimp (factory) or screw (workshop) type.

assemblyMethod.screw: Manual assembly with Allen key (M5 or M6)

zawya.usage: Connects sash corners. Crimp cleats are stronger but require factory machine. Screw cleats are for manual workshop assembly.

shish.description: Monoblock aluminum shutter that rolls up into a box above the window. Provides security, privacy, and sun protection.
shish.usage: Very popular in Egyptian high-end apartments (80% penetration in Cairo/Alexandria). Box mounted above window, reduces actual window height.

latish.description: Aluminum bars inside double glazing unit for decorative effect. Popular in New Cairo villas.

technicalDetails.installation: Inside double glazing unit (between glass panes)

latish.usage: Decorative element. Adds 15-25% to glass cost. Charged by linear meter.

duran.description: Profile bending service for arched windows. Charged per 'Fatha' (one bend), not per meter.

technicalDetails.glassTemplate: Astamba required for custom curved glass

duran.usage: Egyptians love arches in villas. Not all profiles can bend. Panda system bends well (500mm min radius).

acp.description: 4mm aluminum composite panel used for kitchen door bottoms. Replaces glass for safety and privacy.
acp.usage: Bottom part of balcony door in kitchen (hides messy floor area). Also used for safety (tempered glass alternative).
